pairs.question: Quaenam summa boni?
pairs.derivation: Riddle-line: question and its self-answer are the two halves of one verse. Question is the interrogative clause up to the '?'; answer is the remainder of the line, capitalized and given a terminal stop.

pairs.question: Quis dives?
pairs.derivation: First of two Q&A pairs on the verse 'Quis dives? qui nil cupiet. Quis pauper? avarus.' Answer ends at the full stop before the next question.

pairs.question: Quis pauper?
pairs.derivation: Second Q&A pair on the same verse 'Quis dives? qui nil cupiet. Quis pauper? avarus.' Answer is the final word, capitalized with terminal stop.

pairs.question: Quae casta est?
pairs.derivation: Riddle-line: interrogative clause answered by the rest of the verse, capitalized with terminal stop.

pairs.question: Quod prudentis opus?
pairs.derivation: Riddle-line: interrogative clause answered by the rest of the verse, capitalized with terminal stop.
